title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could view child…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks can view child playbook status and loop-state metadata for playbook runs outside their authorized scope. This occurs because the playbook status API does not properly bind the requested run to the current execution context before returning metadata.
